name: Jig factory
description: Turns an idea into an interview, a polished demo and a full pack of documents and material: each run goes through its stages in chats of its own, in a worktree on its own branch, stopping at gates for you. Runs on a floor in lanes (Interview, Demo, Review, Pack, Launch, Done), each run's stages, outputs and timeline, and an inbox of everything waiting for a person across projects. Sample runs show how it works.

actions.title: Jig factory: start from a brief…

tools.description: Gives this Jig factory stage its run: the brief, the plan, the files the stage reads and writes, the outputs so far and any changes asked at a gate. Only in a chat that runs a stage of a Jig factory run (its instructions say so).

The interviewer posts question cards for the person: 3 to 5 per round, each with a suggested answer and, when it helps, options. End your turn after calling it; the answers come back as your next message. Only in a chat that runs a stage of a Jig factory run (its instructions say so).

questions.description: The cards: [{ text, suggestion, options? }], text the question, suggestion the answer you'd propose, options a few short choices

tools.description: Reports that this Jig factory stage is done: the files it wrote (relative to the run's folder), a two-line summary and notes for the reviewer; a critic also gives quality { pass, score }. Set failed when the stage couldn't do its work. Call it once, at the end, then end your turn. Only in a chat that runs a stage of a Jig factory run (its instructions say so).

summary.description: What the stage made, in one or two sentences

outputs.description: The files written, relative to the run's folder, e.g. ["scout.md"]; the main one first

notes.description: Short lines for the reviewer: decisions, open points; a critic's fix list

quality.description: Critique stages only: { pass: boolean, score: number 0-100 }

failed.description: true when the stage couldn't do its work (it is retried once, then waits for a person)

tools.description: This Jig factory stage can't go on without a person: the run shows your question and waits. End your turn after calling it; the answer comes back in this chat. Only in a chat that runs a stage of a Jig factory run (its instructions say so).

question.description: What you need to know or need done, in one or two sentences

tools.description: Lists a project's Jig factory runs: their state, the stages running, the gates and stages waiting for a person, and how many outputs each has. Use it when asked how the factory is doing.

project.description: The project's name or id; leave out for this chat's project
